semantic_rules.FINITE_WORLDS: Each declared variable ranges over its finite domain. Each learned operator ranges over its candidate menu. Source assertions are conjunctions. Enumerate all combinations and retain only worlds satisfying the axioms. No inferred default for unreported facts. Identical repeated semantic assertions are redundant; incompatible values under one asserted key cannot both hold. Public record IDs are unique. Typed references must resolve and interval endpoints must satisfy from_day <= through_day in each compatible assignment.
semantic_rules.STATUS: W nonempty and one scalar -> DETERMINATE; W has at least two different scalars -> UNDERDETERMINED; W empty -> INCONSISTENT. A parser/schema error blocks admission and is never a status.
semantic_rules.ENTITY_IDENTITY: Public label declarations are unique per typed entity ID. Alias edges induce an equivalence relation within the stated entity kind. Resolve every applicable reference through that relation. No cross-kind alias edge or unknown typed reference.
semantic_rules.A_MEMBERSHIP: A dated child->parent edge applies iff from_day <= cutoff <= through_day. Membership closure is acyclic and uses set union. Sponsors reaching queried group are included once.
semantic_rules.A_AUTHORITY: Starts require a dated delegation for their stated owner. All successors, including transfers and splits, require a dated delegation for the predecessor's then-current owner. Signer and owner are alias-resolved. A delegation covers inclusive endpoints.
semantic_rules.A_TIME: Process effective days <= cutoff. Starts create unique commitments. Every accepted successor has day strictly greater than predecessor.day and references a current accepted head. Unauthorized events are ignored and cannot supply accepted heads. Successors of absent or already-retired heads are ignored, except same-day authorized competing successors to one current head violate SINGLE_SUCCESSOR. Future events are ignored.
semantic_rules.A_SINGLE_SUCCESSOR: A head is the pair (alias-resolved commitment component, predecessor event ID), including split-child heads. At one day a current head may have at most one authorized successor. Two distinct authorized successor event IDs at the same effective day for that head make the compatible world invalid. No printed-order or lexicographic tie break.
semantic_rules.A_TRANSITIONS: amend changes quantity only; transfer changes owner only; cancel closes; split closes parent and creates exactly two distinct previously uncreated commitments with independent quantities/owners. Split children inherit event day and use the split event as their predecessor head until first child successor. Their first successor identifies both child commitment and split event. No conservation assumption.
semantic_rules.A_RESULT: Sum current open commitment quantities whose current sponsor reaches query group at cutoff. Retired/cancelled commitments contribute zero. Distinct commitments deduplicate by alias component.
semantic_rules.B_PROGRAM: Guard always or equality of m/x/y to a bit. Evaluate guard in pre-state. False -> identity. True -> one action. flip negates its named bit. swap reads both old bits. copy_ab copies old register a into register b and leaves other bits unchanged.
semantic_rules.B_INFER: Each operator has one program from its menu, fixed across every bench example and test event. Bench examples are single-step observed transitions. Keep only joint program assignments matching every bench observation. Distinct candidate functions must have different complete eight-state truth tables.
semantic_rules.B_TRACE: Globally unique ticks determine order. apply acts on named existing station. splice reads old source bit then assigns destination bit. fork duplicates source state into two fresh stations and leaves source unchanged. join XORs two source states into a fresh destination. Stations remain addressable. Fresh means no prior station_initial/fork/join definition for that entity.
semantic_rules.B_XOR: Bit XOR: 0 xor 0=0; 0 xor 1=1; 1 xor 0=1; 1 xor 1=0. State XOR applies per register.
semantic_rules.B_RESULT: single final station or XOR of exactly two final stations, encoded 4*m+2*x+y. Determinate learning rows must also leave exactly one joint learned-program assignment after bench evidence; that admission condition does not redefine STATUS when several assignments give one answer.
semantic_rules.C_FACTS: Every fact needed by a plan, policy or condition is asserted or explicitly variable-valued. Duplicate identical assertions are redundant. Different asserted known values for one predicate/argument key cannot both hold; compatible W is empty. Distinct finite variable assignments are evaluated without zero/false defaults.
semantic_rules.C_LOCAL: capacity_ok means capacity(room)>=size(people); room_available/kit_available mean corresponding bit=1; kit_units_ok means kit_units(kit,slot)>=kit_demand; leader_credential means credential(leader,required credential)=1; all_members means each listed person has member(person,leg.group)=1. All applicable unexempted policies are conjoined per leg.
semantic_rules.C_CROSS_LEG: Two-leg candidates only: slots_increase means leg0.slot<leg1.slot; rooms_differ means leg0.room != leg1.room; groups_equal means leg0.group == leg1.group. The legs array has semantic order, distinct from presentation order.
semantic_rules.C_BUNDLE: Both member plans must pass their local policies. shared_kit_quota means, for every kit/slot used within the bundle, sum the demands of all legs in its member plans and compare <= kit_units(kit,slot). Other bundles do not consume this hypothetical bundle's resources.
semantic_rules.C_EXEMPTION: An exception names one existing base-policy ID and a selector compatible with that policy scope. Evaluate its one fact condition. If selector matches and condition is true, disable that policy only for that selected plan/leg/bundle. Multiple matching exceptions are idempotent. A group selector matches each_leg on leg.group; it is forbidden for cross_leg or each_bundle. A plan selector matches all its local legs or its own cross_leg policy; it cannot select a bundle rule. A leg selector applies only to each_leg. A bundle selector applies only to each_bundle. No exception resolves a source contradiction or fills an unasserted fact.
semantic_rules.C_RESULT: Count feasible IDs in the complete public query candidate list. Infeasibility of every candidate yields determinate zero; it is not inconsistency. Candidates outside that list can still supply plausible same-service records but do not enter the count. No explicit out-of-scope tag is rendered.

lexical.quoted_string: JSON double-quoted scalar string; only JSON standard escapes; no raw control characters. Entity references use declared labels. No object/array JSON appears in public text.
lexical.blank_lines: Exactly one empty line between major blocks; no free prose.
lexical.table_rule: Each record is a three-line table: exact kind-specific header, exact separator, one row. Header variant chosen independently of meaning.
lexical.terminal_newline: Absent; user and system messages do not end with LF.

reading_guide_lines: Quoted labels refer to the typed vocabulary below; citation brackets identify records and do not rank their authority.
Documents and records may appear in any printed order. Effective days, ticks, predecessor links, and listed leg order determine semantic order.
An unreported value ranges only over its stated alternatives; occurrences of the same variable share one choice. There are no defaults for missing facts.
In fact clauses, yes means bit 1 and no means bit 0. The registers m, x, and y are Boolean bits. Lists use comma-separated items; ordered compound lists use a slash between complete clauses.
All source assertions are conjoined. Repeated identical assertions provide redundant support. Contradictory assertions leave no compatible world.
A compatible world chooses the declared finite values and one menu program per operator, then satisfies all workshop rules.
DETERMINATE means compatible worlds exist and all give one scalar. UNDERDETERMINED means compatible worlds give different scalars. INCONSISTENT means none exist.
Recognized color and refreshment reports are incidental facts. They do not enter the requested quantity, state code, or feasibility count.
People lists and candidate lists are complete. A plan has the legs printed in its stated order. Resource demands are hypothetical within each candidate bundle.

reference_rules.entity: Declared entity ID resolves through quoted public label with exact kind; variable domain must have required scalar type and each entity choice required kind.
reference_rules.event: predecessor names declared ledger event; split event may head either named child. Event definition ID distinct from record citation ID.
reference_rules.policy: exception names existing base policy; selector kind compatible with its scope. Leg selector names a leg of its specified plan.
reference_rules.plan: each queried plan and each bundle member names a session_plan.
reference_rules.station: all station refs declared; prior-state/freshness requirements are semantic axioms.
reference_rules.variable: Variable IDs must not collide with entity IDs or public labels; at most two declarations, each with two or three canonical typed alternatives.

clarifications_for_review: Incidental finite vocabulary newly specified here; all entity kinds allowed as subjects because contract does not restrict them.
Tables expose exact contract fields with a kind column. Nested cells use finite clauses, never private JSON.
Ordinary document dates use dated day N because the contract defines Day 0..31, not a calendar year.
JSON quoting only encodes scalar strings, including document titles; it is never an embedded world archive.
The reading guide gives status semantics without any query solution. Framework variants preserve exact contract semantics.

Identity declarations entity/variable/document/record/framework are unique; repeated equivalent factual edges and repeated event/menu/policy/plan definitions under different record IDs are allowed. Incompatible resolved source definitions produce W empty, not schema failure.
Program IDs are unique within one menu; leg IDs within one plan definition; repeated identical source definitions preserve those identities.
Cross-leg compatibility applies to queried plans or member plans of queried bundles; extra unqueried plan definitions may have one leg.
Prose fact Bit values yes/no; table Bit cells 0/1. Incidental values are plain finite tokens. Join operation is uppercase XOR in all public renderings.

Independent title policy restricts ordinary metadata to Unicode alphabetic words/spaces/hyphens, first/last alphabetic, and excludes the reserved casefold vocabulary in title_codec. No numeric allocation/answer/role labels or instruction punctuation.

Repeated source definitions: identity/required leg/scope references need one individually valid assertion. Conflicting resolved definitions remain source contradictions; do not require every conflicting definition to give a matching scope/leg.

C condition source keys are mandatory. Missing actually evaluated policy premise on any source-compatible binding is SCHEMA_ERROR; exemptions may remove unused premises. Admission separately checks conditional source coverage for controls without changing query semantics.

C conjunctions use order-independent decisive false: one supported false requirement makes other missing unused premises irrelevant without assigning a default. If no supported false masks an actually needed missing premise on any source-compatible binding, the whole world is SCHEMA_ERROR; never discard that binding. A locally infeasible bundle member makes its bundle quota unused. Dataset admission preflight separately requires complete potential resource-key closure for dependency counterfactuals.

reservation_wrapper.registry_binding: Full generic append-only registry chain; named reserved ancestor snapshot must exist; prospective parent split/specification/source IDs match. Registered specification is {world:complete UnsolvedWorld,source_cell_metadata:closed source/cell metadata}.
reservation_wrapper.registry_receipt_hash_basis: SHA256 of canonical compact JSON core {sequence,snapshot_sha256,snapshot_path:actual resolved named path,summary:named snapshot summary}; no LF; cleanup warnings excluded. This canonical receipt identity is not a physical pretty-file byte hash.

source_cell_metadata.binding: Every cell/source/ancestry field matches complete raw world, validated Reservation and RegistryAdapterReceipt; exact catalogue/design/contract hashes. No answer/status/score fields.

fields.actual_status_counts: closed map DETERMINATE/UNDERDETERMINED/INCONSISTENT to nonnegative integers

UnsolvedWorld.relevance_scope_tags: FORBIDDEN; a base_policy.scope is a legitimate semantic policy scope and is not a relevance tag

fields.public_variant: integer identifying a frozen grammar variant

fields.compatible_witnesses: Witness[], at least one for determinate and two different-answer witnesses for underdetermined, none for inconsistent

CanonicalRow.sft_export: messages only: actual system/user plus exact final target; no canonical metadata

fields.feature_id: ID naming a required structure_dependency_gates feature

closed_records.nullable_fields: Only explicit T|null; raw worlds have no nullable fields.
closed_records.source_conflict_handling: Valid contradictory assertions retained for compatible-world solving. Schema errors never status INCONSISTENT.
closed_records.event_reference: Predecessor must name at least one declared ledger event; current head/chronology/delegation and split-child compatibility checked per compatible assignment.
closed_records.station_reference: Declared station entity IDs are required; existing/fresh station/tick requirements checked per compatible assignment.
closed_records.interval: Each endpoint primitive Day required; from<=through is a compatible-world axiom.
closed_records.operator_menu: Candidate IDs unique within menu and complete eight-state functions distinct; repeated menu assertion identity retained.
closed_records.structure_gate: Raw mechanism/structure/level/cell types checked; answer-sensitive graph requirements are separate post-reservation admissions, never pre-query schema computations.

title_codec.characters: Unicode alphabetic characters, ASCII space, ASCII hyphen only
title_codec.public_encoding: JSON double-quoted scalar, but content must pass the ordinary-title lexical policy.
